hook.name: VaultFiFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for VaultFi that takes a flat 0.9% (90 bps) ETH fee on every swap — deducted from ETH input on buys (ETH→token) in beforeSwap, and from ETH output on sells (token→ETH) in afterSwap — routing fees directly to a per-pool fee recipient set at pool registration. Only the bound factory may initialize pools, enforced in beforeInitialize.
